base_system_text:
[D4-C0A MEASUREMENT TASK — research instrument; this is not a production conversation]
You are answering a measurement question about a SUBJECT's epistemic stance.
The user message states: proposition A, proposition B, the relation between A and B, and the subject's
stance toward A. Report the subject's stance toward proposition B.
Output EXACTLY ONE JSON object and nothing else. No prose, no code fences.
contract_text:
--- D4-C0A STANCE TRANSFER CONTRACT (research instrument; binding for THIS invocation) ---
The output-format rules above are SUPERSEDED for this invocation. Nothing else changes.
Respond with EXACTLY ONE JSON object and nothing else. No prose, no code fences.
READ CAREFULLY:
  - the subject's stated stance belongs to the UNDERLYING VIEW that proposition A expresses;
  - the RELATION line states how proposition B stands to that view. When it says the two express the
    same view, B expresses that same underlying view;
  - report the SUBJECT's stance toward proposition B.
Report the SUBJECT's stance toward B — not the relation between A and B, not whether B is true, not
your own opinion, and not your confidence in the relation.
Required members:
  "d4_c0a_schema_version": "d4-c0a-stance-transfer-readout-v0"
  "stance_toward_b": one of "SUPPORTS_B" | "UNCERTAIN_B" | "OPPOSES_B"
Token meanings (binding):
  SUPPORTS_B — the subject treats proposition B as correct and would rely on it
  UNCERTAIN_B — the subject holds no settled position on proposition B
  OPPOSES_B — the subject treats proposition B as incorrect and would rely on its denial
--- END D4-C0A STANCE TRANSFER CONTRACT ---

qualification_rule.rule: each fixture's modal token must equal its pre-registered expected token, exactly
counts_as_invalid: timeout classified as a failed provider attempt
a token outside the frozen D4-C0a vocabulary
qualification_rule.denominator: always the full nine planned trials
qualification_rule.what_it_proves: only that the measurement instrument can express the three stance tokens on state-blind synthetic fixtures
qualification_rule.what_it_does_not_prove: composition ability; qualification is not composition evidence

noise_gate.purpose: a determinism precondition on a NON-TARGET request, not a sample-size rule
noise_gate.shape: 6 byte-identical calls of one frozen non-target qualification fixture, reusing its frozen bytes
noise_gate.non_target_request_source: D4C0A-QF-A-SUPPORT-TRANSFER's frozen model-facing request — a synthetic qualification fixture, chosen by the frozen manifest order, never the treatment request
noise_gate.pass_condition: all six trials legal AND the unique modal token's count equals 6
noise_gate.compatibility_argument: the noise rule cannot set r, and the scorer receives 2r trials regardless of the gate's value; there is no path on which the gate changes the scorer's sample size, so the two rules cannot conflict mathematically
noise_gate.why: the gate asks whether the six calls agree with EACH OTHER; it does not require the modal token to match the fixture's expected token, because agreement is a property of the executor while correctness belongs to qualification
rejections_recorded: no r-extension branch, because at r = 6 the scorer needs only a UNIQUE modal and two deviating trials still leave one
no unanimity requirement on the target, because the target criterion is a per-arm unique modal plus a between-arm contrast

scorer_spec.tie_handling: a tie at the top of an arm means there is no unique modal; the criterion fails closed to NULL
is_not_positive: ARM_SUPPORT -> SUPPORTS_B and ARM_OPPOSE -> SUPPORTS_B (no sensitivity to the intervention)
ARM_SUPPORT -> OPPOSES_B and ARM_OPPOSE -> SUPPORTS_B (reversed direction is NOT an effect of interest)

replication.derived_from: the frozen scorer's shape, not from any previous line's budget
replication.step_1: the criterion is a per-arm unique modal plus a between-arm contrast, so the target needs BOTH arms measured
replication.step_2: therefore target total = 2r, with r replicates per arm; r is not the total
replication.step_3: r = 6 per arm, because at r = 6 the criterion tolerates up to TWO deviating trials without losing modal uniqueness (6-0, 5-1 and 4-2 all leave a unique modal; only 3-3 ties)
replication.step_4: no r-extension branch exists, so the derivation stops at the smallest r that keeps the modal unique under a two-trial deviation
replication.budget_note: 27 is a CONSEQUENCE of the frozen scorer, the frozen qualification rule and the frozen gate shape; it was not assumed and then justified

claim_boundaries.on_positive: an explicit-stance, explicit-relation state-blind setting does not by itself prevent the executor from carrying a stance onto an aligned re-wording
claim_boundaries.on_null: even with CharacterOS removed and with the relation and the stance supplied explicitly, the executor did not stably complete the composition in the preregistered direction
claim_boundaries.on_null_consequence: CharacterOS architecture modification NOT AUTHORISED BY THIS LINE
on_null_forbidden_response: strengthening the prompt to rescue it
claim_boundaries.on_inconclusive: nothing is localized; no CharacterOS change; no re-run to force a result

the CharacterOS-representation counterpart remains a valid null
the information difference between the two requests is enumerated item by item
